title: Resident bicycle parking: 0.5 spaces per dwelling, rounded up (Table 3.9)
text: Secure, undercover bicycle parking is provided in accordance with Table 3.9 and accessed via a continuous path of travel from the vehicle or cycle entry point. Table 3.9 Bicycle parking: Resident 0.5 space per dwelling.
notes: from: ch4p1 C2.3.7. Table 3.9 footnote 1: rounded up to the next whole number (round(x + 0.4999) is ceiling for these ratios). diverges: ch4p1 Table 2.3a rounds to the nearest whole number for the same rates (register C4P2-104). Same rate in Location A and B. Security, cover and path limbs are A3.9.1-r2.
